definitions.explanation: The components or ingredients that go into a dish, particularly soups, stews, or dishes with multiple mixed elements. Refers to the solid pieces rather than the liquid or base.

examples.japanese: {味噌汁|みそしる}の{具材|ぐざい}は{豆腐|とうふ}と{若布|わかめ}です。
examples.english: The ingredients in the miso soup are tofu and wakame.

examples.japanese: ピザの{具材|ぐざい}を{自由|じゆう}に{選|えら}べます。
examples.english: You can freely choose the pizza toppings.

examples.japanese: {鍋|なべ}の{具材|ぐざい}を{準備|じゅんび}しておく。
examples.english: I'll prepare the ingredients for the hot pot.

notes:
USAGE: {具材|ぐざい} specifically refers to the solid ingredients or components that go into a dish. It differs from {材料|ざいりょう} (ingredients/materials in general) by emphasizing the pieces that are visible in the final dish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{味噌汁|みそしる}の{具材|ぐざい} (miso soup ingredients)
・{鍋|なべ}の{具材|ぐざい} (hot pot ingredients)
・サンドイッチの{具材|ぐざい} (sandwich fillings)
・おにぎりの{具材|ぐざい} (rice ball fillings)
・{具材|ぐざい}たっぷり (loaded with ingredients)

DISTINCTION:
・{具材|ぐざい} - ingredients visible in a dish (tofu in soup, toppings on pizza)
・{材料|ざいりょう} - ingredients in general (including seasonings, base ingredients)
・{具|ぐ} - short form, often used for fillings (おにぎりの{具|ぐ})

RELATED:
・{汁物|しるもの} (soup dish)
